primary_decision.conclusion: Independent confirmation did not establish retention gains over all three required controls; do not promote a new method.
primary_decision.scope: Conjunctive single-claim test, not a search over arms or conditions; descriptive secondary intervals are not multiplicity-corrected.

predictor_audit.delayed_surprise_semantics: q-time memory/context with controls realized by q+3; targets are never model inputs

limits: Same generator family; independent seeds do not establish new-task generalization.
Fixed feature-MSE criterion can reward reader/timing effects; task contrast is descriptive, not physical success.
One frozen shuffled-label seed is a negative control, not a full permutation test.
Same K and paired probe capacity; different baseline total bytes/compute reported separately.
